integrity: General symbolic proof provided. Direct executable checks are finite corroboration only; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for ordinary ordered G-partition semigroups with finite abelian G, all n,r>=1. Does not cover nonabelian colors or arbitrary noncommuting factorizations. Classical uncolored r=2 total already known; literature equivalence remains a residual risk.
title: Uniform commuting-tuple product fibers in abelian-group-colored partition monoids
